obfuscation_indicators: known and unknown risks and uncertainties
risk_summary: The excerpt is predominantly precise and quantitatively detailed, with clear year-over-year revenue, margin, and expense comparisons. Risk is moderate because operating costs, food prices, labor costs, and package-store margins are expected to deteriorate or rise, although revenue trends are positive. Boilerplate forward-looking disclaimers and complex consolidation and related-party structures modestly reduce transparency.
